name: Signal
notes: Inspiration: the feeling of hidden code made visible — translated, not copied: a small ticking counter in the corner instead of falling character rain, and every connecting line moves in right-angle grid-hops instead of a smooth curve, like a packet hopping a network. Monochrome dark ground, one bright accent, system-log/monospace typography for any on-screen labels. Best fit for technical/developer-facing subjects; a narrower fit for history, culture or music content where the terminal feeling reads as a mismatch — see Halo for something more universal.
